summary.text: Bill Hager is a Republican engineer and manager who has represented District 122 in the South Carolina House of Representatives since November 14, 2022, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Bill Hager was born in Charlotte, North Carolina, and lives in Hampton, South Carolina.
Hager earned a B.S. from The Citadel in 1984, and his career experience includes work as an engineer and engineering manager with SCE&G.
He has served as president of the Beaufort Exchange Club and chairman of the Hampton County Economic Development Commission.
Hager succeeded Shedron Williams as the District 122 representative.
For 2025-2026 he is assigned to the Labor, Commerce and Industry Committee.
